run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the stable sorted position of an element at a given index in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify stable sort position calculation correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts elements smaller or equal-before to determine stable sort position
review_f_gold: review f_gold logic that compares array elements to compute stable sort ranking for a given index
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the linear scan with a more efficient stable sort position algorithm
